title: Episode 1 timing verified; credit repair stays experimental.
summary: The current version of episode 1 preserves the original timing and drawing in sampled stills. A new ending-credit test fixes darkened lettering locally, but full motion review remains pending.
problem: Cleanup can damage real lettering when stationary credits are mistaken for moving text.
response: Reject the damaged ending test. Keep the current episode version and review the new local correction before adoption.
beforeDetail: Stationary white ending lettering darkened by the rejected test
afterDetail: The same frame and crop with brighter lettering in the new local test
imageNote: New reviewed comparison from today: rejected ending test versus a local correction, not the episode 1 render.
stageNote: Step 3 of the four-step review cycle: check the result and retain the better-supported version.
nextStep: Watch episode 1 continuously for texture, lines and motion. Validate the pending full ending test separately.

dispatchHistory.decision: Keep the version without added synthetic grain as the reference.

dispatchHistory.title: Action lines cleaner; broad cleanup stays on hold.
dispatchHistory.summary: Matching the original picture fields reduces comb-like lines in a reviewed episode 1 action frame. Other flagged scenes mostly show intentional drawing or effects, so broad cleanup remains unapproved.
dispatchHistory.decision: Keep field matching as a candidate for action. Do not apply broad smoothing or train on unconfirmed defects.

dispatchHistory.title: Local noise tests remain subtle; broad cleanup stays on hold.
dispatchHistory.summary: New tests change the marked episode 1 picture only slightly. They do not yet separate unwanted outline noise from real drawing, so the current version remains the reference.
dispatchHistory.decision: Keep the new tests local and experimental. Require a confirmed noise halo and a nearby line to preserve before preparing training examples.
